page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.16-256 is an arm64 instance in the Standard family, configured with a high memory-to-CPU allocation to support memory-demanding infrastructure. The instance is powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor platform, providing 32 dedicated physical cores mapped directly to 32 vCPUs. Because each core executes exactly one hardware thread, workloads avoid the resource contention and noisy-neighbor issues common to simultaneous multithreading designs.

System memory is provisioned at 256.0 GB, yielding a high density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The server includes no bundled local storage, requiring attached network block storage volumes for persistent data workloads. It operates without discrete GPU acceleration hardware and is provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address for external network connectivity.

The single-threaded core model combined with substantial memory density yields consistent execution characteristics and predictable scaling for ARM-compatible software stacks. The lack of integrated NVMe drives introduces a reliance on network storage throughput for file operations. VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.16-256 is appropriate for in-memory data stores, distributed caching systems, analytical data processing pipelines, and ARM-native backend application deployments.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.16-256 is an arm64 compute instance designed for memory-intensive and multi-threaded enterprise applications. The virtual machine is powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor architecture, providing 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs with a single thread per core to eliminate resource contention between sibling threads. System memory is configured at 256.0 GB, resulting in an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring attached network block storage for persistent data requirements, and operates without discrete GPU acceleration. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. With its high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated core model, the configuration offers predictable core density and efficient resource scaling. VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.16-256 is suited for in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, data processing pipelines, and ARM-native containerized microservices.
